AntiPattern.Bad: Story named `OpensModalOnClick` consists only of `args: { ... }` and no `play` function; the user-flow concept is documentation, not an executable contract.
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Interactive story without `play` (`AX_SB_USE_PLAY_FOR_INTERACTION`). The self-verification loop has nothing to assert against; `run-story-tests` will pass trivially without exercising the flow that the story name claims to verify.
AntiPattern.Good: Add `play: async ({ canvasElement, step }) => { const canvas = within(canvasElement); await userEvent.click(canvas.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open' })); await expect(canvas.getByRole('dialog')).toBeVisible(); }`.
